design_choices_documented: Chose static-source-grep test pattern over Vue mount because sister specs use the same convention (kioskCounterPaymentFlow.spec.js, KioskPaymentRestyle.spec.js) — mounting KioskPaymentComponent in isolation would require mocking Vuex kioskCart store, vue-router, axios, kioskHardware, useKioskSpeech composable, and 5+ other dependencies, all to assert template/data contract that grep-on-source verifies more cheaply and just as reliably.

Namespaced new flag under window.foodkingConfig.kiosk (not flat) so future kiosk-runtime flags can be grouped there. Existing kioskAutoLogin/kioskDefaultLocale/kioskMenuPricing remain at the root for backwards compat — only the new flag uses the kiosk namespace.

Reused existing 'cash' method routing instead of inventing new payment_method code 1 path: confirmCounterRoute pins method='cash' and delegates to confirmPayment which already handles cash via processCashPayment. This means zero duplication of cart-submit, idempotency, quote-refresh, navigation logic — and the existing B5b contract (no drawer at kiosk, navigation to kiosk.cash-instruction) is automatically inherited.
Gated each legacy UI block via ANDing !paymentRouteAllToCounter into existing v-if — does not require restructuring template into v-if/v-else branches, keeps diff minimal and reviewer-friendly.

Default flag value = TRUE per owner mandate (Plan B is the V1 baseline). Override via KIOSK_PAYMENT_ROUTE_ALL_TO_COUNTER=false in .env to fall back to legacy method-selection UI for staging/QA scenarios that want to test card/TR flow.
